scope: Fixed field scene, actual Tk controls and two window sizes; no camera access or source mutation
design_thesis: Photographs, conditional section estimates and CAD acceptance remain distinct, with the next necessary step visible beside evaluation.

findings.problem: Workflow quality states were hidden below long saved-path messages in the scrolling status area.
findings.fix: Persistent two-line summary beside the existing evaluate button distinguishes loaded pairs from repetition checks, viewing side, solved conditional sections, CAD correspondence, plane validation, applied trial and relative-position acceptance.
findings.quote: Consider integrating status feedback into your interface.

findings.problem: Saving with a pending camera-side preview silently discarded that preview when the viewer synchronized with saved settings.
findings.fix: An inline message returns focus to the viewer before saving; the operator can apply the side or restore the already applied direction. Neither action is silently selected by software.
findings.quote: Give clear guidance and use consistent language throughout processes with multiple steps.

findings.problem: Single-frame candidate details claimed they were using a burst; unresolved top red pipe was described only as unpaired.
findings.fix: Single-frame and rejected-burst text are separate. New pairing audit shows independent edge counts, width mismatch and why two visible lines cannot determine a free circle.

findings.problem: CAD table text colors on the production white background had contrast ratios 4.29, 4.22 and 2.69, all below 4.5 for small text.
findings.fix: Separate table text colors from photo-outline colors. New text ratios are 7.13, 6.57 and 6.65. State names remain explicit. Scrolling diagnostic text increased from 9 pt to 10 pt, with two lines retained to preserve photograph height.
findings.quote: Strive to meet color contrast minimum standards.

findings.problem: Long rejection strings on every image proposal covered the actual pipe silhouettes.
findings.fix: Photo labels now retain proposal IDs; detailed rejection text remains in diagnostics. Candidate rectangles and algorithm output remain intact.
findings.remaining: Dense overlapping proposals remain crowded at 1024x720; opening the scene model and selecting a row provides the clearer per-candidate view.

limitations: No screen-reader certification, operating-system high-contrast audit or universal DPI certification. Apple references are applied as cross-platform principles, not as a claim of macOS HIG compliance for Windows Tk. Current numerical results are still conditional and have not become accepted by these presentation changes.
